blocks.text: The Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS) uses a virtual machine (VM) to stream traffic logs in real time from the Zscaler Nanolog to your security information and event management (SIEM) system, enabling real-time alerting, correlation with the logs of your other devices, and long-term local log archival. An NSS server is the representation of the NSS VM in the Zscaler Admin Console.
NSS servers provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Issue a client certificate and a private key that you can install on the NSS VM.
Assign up to 16 NSS feeds to a server. (Session Logs are limited to 8 feeds per server to ensure optimal performance.)

blocks.text: On the NSS Servers page (Data Explorer > Log Streaming > NSS Servers), you can:
To learn more about adding an NSS server and deploying an NSS virtual appliance, see the NSS Deployment Guides.

blocks.item: View a list of all configured NSS servers.
Server Name: The name of the server.
Type: The server type, which is set to NSS for Firewall, Cloud and Branch Connector by default.
State: The health state of the server.
